scope_note: The sources establish the unrestricted CNF-in-an-affine-subspace / union-of-subspaces hardness context and classical finite-field arrangement counting. C042 is an elementary laminar specialization with proof-carrying discovery and does not solve general subspace avoidance or P versus NP.

sources.title: CNF Satisfiability in a Subspace and Related Problems
sources.role: Primary comparison for CNF satisfiability in an input subspace, its equivalent Union-of-Subspace Avoidance and product-of-affine-forms formulations, and the NP-hardness boundary of unrestricted 2-SUB-SAT.

sources.title: Subspace Arrangements over Finite Fields: Cohomological and Enumerative Properties
sources.role: Primary context for counting points on and off unions of finite-field linear or affine subspaces through arrangement and intersection-poset combinatorics.

sources.title: Affine Dispersers from Subspace Polynomials
sources.role: Context for explicit algebraic operations on affine subspaces over finite fields; not used as a hidden solver.
Internal fixed-language reduction showing that unrestricted Horn-affine composition contains arbitrary 3-SAT.
Internal predecessor proving that canonical coordinate substitution reconstructs the source 3-CNF, so C042 must require an independently verified tractable arrangement certificate.
Internal predecessor for provenance-carrying Gaussian elimination and symbolic affine projection; C042 nevertheless charges its input basis construction directly rather than treating a basis as free.
